g.text: Every point is a paired block; no tail observations are discarded. Pale region: positive minimum-EE gain and actual loss <=10%.
Dashed line marks 10% actual loss for evaluation, not an execution guarantee. Crosses: actual block QoS failures; open circle: reference.
Signed asinh x-axis preserves the sign and displays the full loss/gain range; displayed tick labels are actual percentages.
